name: Bhavesh Gaur
head: Senior Manager - Sales & Business Development, Indium
text: Senior Manager - Sales & Business Development, Indium

strengths: 12 yrs BD; runs one of Indium's top accounts and pursues new opportunities
Ex-Deloitte and EY; Indium also sells QE, so he is close to testing deals
gaps: Account he runs is data/AI, not QE
Some of the role is account management rather than new logos
screen.next: Ask whether he has sold Indium's QE offerings

name: Karthik Ramadoss
head: Sr Vice President - Strategic Engagement, Indium
text: Sr Vice President - Strategic Engagement, Indium

strengths: Chennai-based; end-to-end BD and bid management; referenced as go-to for high-value deals
gaps: SVP and likely 18+ yrs, above band and budget
